decisions.reason: Product A has only a brief website mention, signaling low public commitment and limited investment, so under escalation of commitment little is lost and the earlier decision requires less justification if it is dropped.
Product B is presented on its own page with a specific launch claim, indicating visible commitment and justifying persistence even if early results are disappointing.
Product C has a dedicated website page, which shows public commitment and makes the firm more likely to retain it rather than write off the visible launch.
